The '''Burba Xenowave Scanner''' was one of [[Fez Burba]]'s many designs. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Neeya]] used such equipment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] to gather readings from [[the Tomb]].
